basis: Top-10 first names (Erstnamen) of babies born in 2025 in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, merged: Germany – Gesellschaft für deutsche Sprache (GfdS), Erstnamenliste 2025, spelling variants combined (https://gfds.de/vornamen/beliebteste-vornamen/); Austria – Statistik Austria, press release 14 225-144/26 of 9 July 2026 (https://www.statistik.at/fileadmin/announcement/2026/07/20260709Vornamen2025.pdf); Switzerland – Federal Statistical Office (BFS), name statistics for 2025 published 21 August 2026. German spellings that appear in these lists (Klara, Jakob, Lukas, Matteo) are added next to the English spellings already in the library.

meaning.en: Clear, bright, famous (German form of Clara)
meaning.es: Clara, luminosa, ilustre (forma alemana de Clara)
meaning.de: Klar, hell, berühmt (deutsche Form von Clara)
meaning.fr: Claire, lumineuse, illustre (forme allemande de Clara)
meaning.pt: Clara, luminosa, ilustre (forma alemã de Clara)

meaning.en: Form of Leah; also a short form of names ending in -lia
meaning.tr: Lea adının bir biçimi; -lia ile biten adların kısaltması da olabilir
meaning.es: Forma de Lea; también diminutivo de nombres terminados en -lia
meaning.de: Form von Lea; auch Kurzform von Namen auf -lia
meaning.fr: Forme de Léa ; aussi diminutif des prénoms en -lia
meaning.pt: Forma de Lea; também forma curta de nomes terminados em -lia

meaning.en: Short for Helena (torch, shining light) or Magdalena
meaning.tr: Helena (meşale, parlayan ışık) ya da Magdalena'nın kısaltması
meaning.es: Diminutivo de Helena (antorcha, luz brillante) o de Magdalena
meaning.de: Kurzform von Helena (Fackel, leuchtendes Licht) oder Magdalena
meaning.fr: Diminutif d'Helena (torche, lumière brillante) ou de Magdalena
meaning.pt: Forma curta de Helena (tocha, luz brilhante) ou de Magdalena

meaning.en: God is gracious (feminine form of Johannes)
meaning.es: Dios es misericordioso (forma femenina de Johannes)
meaning.de: Gott ist gnädig (weibliche Form von Johannes)
meaning.fr: Dieu fait grâce (forme féminine de Johannes)
meaning.pt: Deus é gracioso (forma feminina de Johannes)

meaning.en: Gift of God (Italian form of Matthew)
meaning.es: Regalo de Dios (forma italiana de Mateo)
meaning.fr: Don de Dieu (forme italienne de Matthieu)
meaning.pt: Presente de Deus (forma italiana de Mateus)

meaning.en: My God is Yahweh (form of Elijah)
meaning.es: Mi Dios es Yahvé (forma de Elías)
meaning.de: Mein Gott ist Jahwe (Form von Elija)
meaning.pt: Meu Deus é Javé (forma de Elias)

meaning.en: Supplanter; holder of the heel (German form of Jacob)
meaning.tr: Yerine geçen; topuğu tutan (Jacob'ın Almanca biçimi)
meaning.es: El que suplanta; el que sujeta el talón (forma alemana de Jacob)
meaning.de: Verdränger; der die Ferse hält (deutsche Form von Jacob)
meaning.fr: Celui qui supplante ; celui qui tient le talon (forme allemande de Jacob)
meaning.pt: Aquele que suplanta; o que segura o calcanhar (forma alemã de Jacó)

meaning.en: From Lucania; light (German form of Lucas)

meaning.fr: De Lucanie ; lumière (forme allemande de Lucas)
meaning.pt: Da Lucânia; luz (forma alemã de Lucas)
